pudge_meat_hook.desc: Hurls a chained hook along a line. The first unit it catches is dragged back to Pudge: enemy heroes take pure damage, ordinary enemy creeps die on the spot, allies are only pulled. Pudge is locked in the throw for a moment.

pudge_rot.desc: Toggle a cloud of rot that burns and slows enemies around Pudge several times a second. It eats at Pudge too, but never kills him.

pudge_flesh_heap.desc: Instantly layers extra flesh on Pudge: for a few seconds every instance of damage he takes is reduced by a flat amount. Usable while channeling Dismember.

pudge_innate_graft_flesh.desc: Every enemy hero Pudge kills, or that dies close to him, permanently adds Strength.

pudge_dismember.desc: Channel: Pudge devours an enemy, holding it helpless and pulling it in while dealing magical damage that grows with his Strength. Pudge heals for all damage dealt. Pierces spell immunity.
